scope: Original kit-specific Stat Focus A/B desk research. Each entry compares an existing source-linked community starting choice with an alternative at equal resources; no gameplay measurements, rights clearance or best-in-slot claim.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Bastion, a Critical Rating trial changes eligible would-be critical event frequency; it must not be assumed to increase noncritical debuff tick damage. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Use medium attacks and well-timed blocks to build Virus charges. Compare Critical Damage Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Do not mistake a changed direct hit for proof of longer resource uptime or stronger debuff ticks.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Bastion on defense, Armor Penetration may improve the defender's outgoing direct hits against armored attackers; it does not reduce incoming damage, so a mitigation choice is a real alternative. Kit limitation: More than three unique opponent buffs prevent new Virus charges. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
statFocusRecommendation.note: Original dated kit-aware editorial comparison; based on the cited champion rotation and Kabam Stat Focus design, not independent combat tests. Existing community setting remains a hypothesis; Critical Rating versus Critical Damage Rating and Armor Penetration versus Block Proficiency are falsifiable alternatives.
